cards.question: What do atomic operations take to control ordering guarantees?
cards.answer: An ordering parameter that controls what guarantees we get about the relative ordering of operations.

cards.question: Why might threads observe operations in different orders?
cards.answer: The CPU might perform operations out of order, such as grouping assignments together even if they are not in that order in the code.

cards.question: What can two threads see when assignments are reordered?
cards.answer: One thread might see V1 V2 V3 assigned, while another sees V2 V3 V1.
